query:
UPDATE step_execution
                SET status = $2, read_count = $3, write_count = $4,
                    filter_count = $5, skip_count = $6, execution_context = $7,
                    ended_at = CASE WHEN $8 THEN COALESCE(ended_at, now()) ELSE ended_at END,
                    exit_message = $9
              WHERE id = $1
